# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Write to [andrey@sitnik.es](mailto:andrey@sitnik.es) or use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/hplush/slowreader/security/advisories/new).

We reply within 3 days and aim to release a fix within 30 days. After the fix is released, we publish an advisory in [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/hplush/slowreader/security/advisories) and credit the reporter unless they ask not to.

## Scope

The hosted app on `slowreader.app`, the `ghcr.io/hplush/slowreader` image, and the source code in this repository.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes.
